t: What is sleeping partner? Simple Definition & Meaning · LSD.Law
s: November 17, 2025 - A sleeping partner, also known as a secret partner, is an individual who invests capital in a partnership and shares in its profits and losses, but does not participate in the active management or daily operations of the business.

t: SLEEPING PARTNER definition | Cambridge English Dictionary
s: From 1817, businessmen spoke of "sleeping partners" in commercial ventures -- people or institutions who did not share in the actual workings of the enterprise.
